# Taksim

Taksim is an Intelligence Control Plane for coding agents.

Canonical site: https://taksim.edgee.tech
Documentation: https://taksim.edgee.tech/docs
Getting started: https://taksim.edgee.tech/docs/getting-started
Pricing: https://taksim.edgee.tech/pricing
Privacy: https://taksim.edgee.tech/privacy

Current client boundary (verified 2026-09-08):
- Claude Code: managed sessions and historical import.
- Codex: managed observation and historical import; native model selection in v0.
- Devin: managed sessions and historical import.
- GitHub Copilot Coding Agent: historical visibility only; no managed launch.

Taksim governs policy, quality, privacy, budget, eligibility, evidence, direct resource selection, and approved provider-native delegation. It is not positioned as a proprietary request-level multi-model router.
